tools.name: get_credits

tools.name: list_genjutsu_templates
tools.description: Read-only browse of Genjutsu Explore templates (not Seedance recipes). When to use: before generate_from_genjutsu_template. Cost: free. Returns: templates, cursor for paging.

tools.name: get_genjutsu_template
tools.description: Read-only detail for one Genjutsu Explore template (slots, prompt, credit cost). When to use: after list_genjutsu_templates. Cost: free. Seedance recipes use get_seedance_recipe instead.

tools.name: generate_from_genjutsu_template
tools.description: Starts a video job from a Genjutsu Explore template; debits credits up to max_credits. When to use: after estimate_cost with matching template_slug and slot inputs. Slot values are upload ids, generation ids, or default:{n} on official templates. prompt overrides when the template allows editing.

tools.name: list_seedance_recipes
tools.description: Read-only browse of Seedance 2.5 recipe templates from Explore: ready-made prompts and settings, text-to-video or image-to-video (start image, optional end image). When to use: the user wants a ready-made Seedance look. Cost: free. Returns: recipes with default settings and price, cursor.

tools.name: get_seedance_recipe
tools.description: Read-only detail for one Seedance recipe: default prompt (editable), image slots, allowed settings (quality, duration, aspect_ratio, generate_audio, bitrate_mode) and the default price. When to use: before generate_from_seedance_recipe. Cost: free.

tools.name: generate_from_seedance_recipe
tools.description: Starts a Seedance 2.5 video from a recipe; debits credits up to max_credits. When to use: after estimate_cost with template_slug set to the recipe slug and the same settings. image_to_video recipes need a start image (upload id, image generation id, or https URL) and may take an end image. tools.description: Polls one generation by id for the signed-in user. When to use: after any generate_* or import completion path. Cost: free (DB reads only). tools.name: my_creations
tools.description: Read-only list of the signed-in user's recent generations. When to use: browsing history without a specific id. Cost: free; include_previews=true may add JPEG previews (bounded). Returns: viewer-oriented list.

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Creates a short-lived upload URL for the signed-in user to add files from their device into their library. When to use: user needs to supply refs (e.g. motion clip). Cost: free. Returns: link id and URL; then check_upload_link until files arrive.

tools.name: check_upload_link
tools.description: Polls a create_upload_link session owned by the signed-in user. When to use: after sharing the upload URL. Cost: free. wait_seconds (0–25) can wait for a new file. Successful uploads appear in list_uploads.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_generation, check_upload_link · Private data: get_credits, import_media_from_url, list_uploads, estimate_cost, check_generation, create_upload_link, check_upload_link · Public sink: import_media_from_url, list_uploads, generate_character_sheet, generate_from_genjutsu_template, generate_from_seedance_recipe, create_upload_link, check_upload_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_generation, check_upload_link · Private data: get_credits, import_media_from_url, list_uploads, estimate_cost, check_generation, create_upload_link, check_upload_link · Public sink: import_media_from_url, list_uploads, generate_character_sheet, generate_from_genjutsu_template, generate_from_seedance_recipe, create_upload_link, check_upload_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
